notes: Sheet rotated against the CBD sheets: 4th, 3rd and Pearl run ENE, Lawrence, Lytle, Pike, Ludlow and Dawson run SSE. E 5th's north face is off the top of the page, so the 5th St points are the south face minus half the 66 ft width. Pike/5th: 5th continues NE beyond Pike (sheet 125 shows it as E. 5th running on east of Pike); the point given is Pike's centreline on the centreline of 5th west of Pike (Pike's pipe curves into it); 5th east of Pike leaves from the same opening heading NE. BUCHANAN St runs Lawrence to Pike, printed 17' near Pike and 25' at the Lawrence end. Lawrence north of 4th has no printed width (faces ~65 px apart, about 19 ft). Lawrence north of 4th is a 25' street (centre x~1165-1190); south of 4th it is 60' running SSE; the two legs meet 4th ~70 px apart along 4th, and Lawrence/4th is recorded as the mean of the two leg crossings (north leg (1190,1830), south leg (1126,1865)), consistent with sheet 118. Ludlow (33') ends at 4th exactly at the 4th St bend. A narrow wedge block lies between Ludlow and Lawrence south of 4th. '?' = unnamed 17' street from Ludlow ENE to Lawrence (T at Lawrence, City Park opposite); it continues the line of Arch Street (sheet 118, 32') west of Ludlow, so the Ludlow point is recorded as Arch/Ludlow cross; the 17' segment's name is not printed. Lytle (40') runs 4th to 3rd (T at both). Pike/4th is a T: the Pike east face is unbroken on this sheet and sheet 125 shows the Pugh Power Building across the 4th St line. Pike/3rd is a cross (3rd continues east on sheet 125). DAWSON ALLEY (10') runs 3rd to Pearl, O'REILLY ALLEY (8', 10' at Lawrence) from Lawrence to Dawson. In the Ludlow-Lawrence block south of 3rd: NORTH ALLEY (8'), CENTRE ALLEY (10') and SOUTH ALLEY (8'); North Alley and O'Reilly Alley meet Lawrence ~145 px apart and are recorded as separate T's. Lawrence continues south of Pearl (blocks of sheets 105/106 on both sides), so Lawrence/Pearl is a cross; Pearl's direction changes slightly at Lawrence (point = middle of the four corners). Ludlow/Pearl point is near the page bottom (Pearl south face off the page). 5th, 3rd and 4th all change direction at Pike: east of Pike (sheet 125) 3rd runs E-W and 5th runs NE. Points were read from block corners and face lines (scale about 3.4 px per ft); pipe junctions were not used as centres.
